interpretation_notes: Target is the ordinal wine 'quality' score (range 3-8). Evaluated by Quadratic Weighted Kappa over 5-fold stratified CV. Tried logistic regression, random forest, gradient boosting, and histogram-GBM as both classifiers and regressors (regressor predictions rounded+clipped to [3,8]). Best model was 'rf_reg' with CV QWK=0.5039. Class distribution is imbalanced (mostly 5-6), so QWK is more informative than accuracy: near-miss predictions (e.g. 5 vs 6) cost much less than far ones (e.g. 5 vs 8). Final submission uses the best model refit on the full training set.
